_doc: Crew defaults and job numbers (read by scripts/crew/crew_member.gd config(), jobs.gd, and fire.gd for room names). hp: the health of a crew member whose species data/species.json does not list (each species sets its own). damage_per_s: fire (standing in a burning cell) and no_air (room pressure below no_air_below, a fraction). heal_per_s: lying on a bed or in a powered medbay (the medbay's stats.heal multiplies it). revive_hp: health a downed crew member comes back with. ion_hp: hit points an ion hit costs each crew member in the room it lands in, per point of its damage (times their damage_taken.ion; see Jobs.ion_hit, which also applies ion_stun). player and ada: the two people every ship starts with (name and PersonDrawer palette). extra_crew: more NPCs spawned at beds, named from names in order and coloured from looks in order. enemy: the crew of a ship that is not the player's (count, names, one palette). jobs: period is how often the job board is rebuilt and handed out (seconds); switch_margin is how much higher a new job's priority must be to pull a crew member off the one they are doing; search limits the work of picking (jobs: how many of the nearest jobs get a path, spots: how many standing spots per job, paths: path searches per hand-out); order_hold is how long a crew member ignores the board after a manual order (middle click). Per job: priority, seconds (work time, times the line's repair multiplier), rate (extinguish: intensity removed per crew member per second; repair_crew: hit points a second restored to a hurt `mechanical` crew member, who beds do not heal), slots (crew that may work it at once). repair_component adds combat_bonus to the priority of parts of combat_families while a fight is on. man_station applies to helm and to the families listed when the part has manned: true. clear_wreck (priority, seconds, slots) clears the debris of a part that was wrecked (docs/CONTENT.md 4f) and gives back half its recipe materials, rounded down. manned: helm_evasion is the evasion a manned helm adds in combat (the arena may read ship.manned later); weapon_cooldown is the fraction a manned weapon's cooldown is shortened by. room_names: the first family found in a room names it in the chronicle. labels: the words of the HUD crew line ({name} is the part, {who} the crew member). traits: crew member name -> list of personal trait ids (ids of the trait library, data/traits.json: suit wears an EVA suit, no_breath, heat_resistant ...); a name that is not listed has none. CrewMember.traits() merges them with the species' traits (data/species.json) and worn gear, and TraitSet.of() (scripts/crew/traits.gd) turns the merged traits into numbers; abilities.gd checks the merged list against an ability's operator_needs.
